commentary: Market breadth remains fragile at 32 despite the benchmark index rebound reclaiming 22,936. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline and William O'Neil's market-direction rules require defensiveness: broad market rallies on narrow leadership require progressive exposure rather than aggressive buying. While headline indices cheered the Federal Reserve rate pause and cooling crude, the deterministic gate is WEAK. Under O'Neil's CANSLIM C-and-A criteria, price setups unsupported by verified 25%+ earnings acceleration must be capped at Watch. Capital is conserved for genuine Stage 2 market leaders emerging out of pristine volatility contraction patterns with demonstrable institutional demand.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

21STCENMGM.technical: Price attempts a double bottom clearing EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on 2.42x volume. MACD is positive, but erratic microcap volume signals poor institutional liquidity.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Investment and capital market trading firm showing erratic revenue with negative annual profitability (ROE -72.8%). Lacks durable operating margins and institutional CANSLIM quality.
21STCENMGM.risk: Failure below the 47.58 swing stop invalidates the bottoming structure; cut losses immediately.

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating near 52-week highs with a double-bottom bounce along the rising 21-EMA. Moving averages are aligned upward with MACD holding firmly above zero.
63MOONS.fundamental: Consolidated bottom line remains negative (Q1 FY27 PAT -Rs 47.6 Cr) despite cybersecurity billing momentum at its subsidiary. Zero debt is offset by negative net margins.
63MOONS.risk: Violation of the 849.29 stop breaches key 21-EMA support, requiring prompt defensive exit.

AAATECH.technical: Cleared a 20-day high at 121.82 on 1.85x volume with RSI 62. Price holds above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, but relative strength remains moderate.
AAATECH.fundamental: IT security consulting firm maintains zero debt and 18.9% operating margins, but Q1 FY27 revenue contracted 11% YoY, failing CANSLIM double-digit hurdles.
AAATECH.risk: Breakdown beneath 102.52 violates recent base structure and moving average support; cut losses fast.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-day high on an exceptional 67.7x volume expansion. Moving averages are aligned above 200-SMA with constructive momentum at RSI 62.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Revenue grew 19% YoY to Rs 704 Cr with 30% EBITDA growth, but reported PAT fell 6.9% YoY on normalized tax rates; ROCE is steady at 12%.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Failure back beneath the 420.40 pivot stop aborts the breakout; execute stop discipline promptly.

ABDL.technical: Orderly double bottom testing neckline resistance on 1.46x volume. Price trades comfortably above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with unextended RSI of 52.
ABDL.fundamental: Millionaire whisky brands drove Q2 FY27 revenue up 15.8% YoY to Rs 1,152 Cr. Healthy ROCE of 18.4% is tempered by margin pressure capping PAT growth at 9.7%.
ABDL.risk: A drop below 705.04 breaks the swing low; exit trade defensively to preserve capital.

ACUTAAS.technical: High-momentum Stage 2 leader breaking out to fresh 52-week highs on 3.67x volume. Clean neckline clearance with bullish MACD and RSI 69 confirming top relative strength.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Stellar CANSLIM profile with Q2 FY27 revenue surging 42.7% YoY and PAT jumping 71.4%. EBITDA margins expanded 920 bps to 40.3% alongside an exceptional 21.5% ROE.
ACUTAAS.risk: A close below the 3555.57 pivot stop compromises the base; adhere to strict Minervini stop discipline.
